info.title: Invoice Integration
info.description: API for Trendyol Seller Invoice Integration - e-Invoice and e-Archive invoice management integration services

tags.name: Invoice Link Management
tags.description: Invoice link sending and deletion operations

post.description:
Suppliers can send the order's invoice link to Trendyol via this method.

**LEGAL OBLIGATION**: Invoice links sent with this service must be accessible for 8 years as required by law.

### Usage Conditions
- If you cannot send the invoice for the relevant order by adding a **PDF** to the encrypted mail address in the order, you have to use this service.
- By triggering this method, Trendyol sends an e-invoice email to Trendyol Customer including the link provided by Supplier.
- Encrypted mail addresses are not fixed customer-based, unique mail is produced for each order.

### Required Fields
- The "invoiceNumber" and "invoiceDateTime" fields will be required for microexport packages but optional for other package types.
- As of **4 August 2023**, you should send "invoiceNumber" and "invoiceDateTime" fields as specified.

### Invoice Number Format
The invoice number must comply with the following conditions to be valid:
- First 3 characters: alphanumeric (letter or number)
- Next 13 characters: numeric
- Total: 16 characters

Format: [3 digit(alphanumeric)][13 digit(numeric)]

**Valid Examples:**
- FRY1234567890123
- FR11234567890123
- F1Y1234567890123
- 1RY1234567890123
- 12Y1234567890123
- 1231234567890123
- F231234567890123

**Invalid Example:**
- FRY12345 (missing digits)

### Invoice Date Time Format
- Data type is long
- Should be greater than 0
- Must be 10 digits (seconds) or 13 digits (milliseconds)

409.description:
Conflict - This error occurs in two situations:
1. An invoice for the submitted ShipmentPackageId may have already been fed
2. The submitted link may have already been fed to another ShipmentPackageId before

post.description:
Invoices that were fed incorrectly before can be deleted through this service and fed again through the send invoice link service.

### Usage
- serviceSourceId: represents the shipmentPackageId value
- channelId: Should always be sent as 1
- customerId: Can be checked on get order packages service

202.description: Accepted - Invoice link deletion request accepted

404.description: Not Found - Specified invoice link not found

post.description:
Allows sellers to upload invoice files (PDF, JPEG, PNG) for order packages.

### Important Rules
- The file size cannot exceed 10 MB
- A future-dated invoice cannot be added
- Supported file formats: PDF, JPEG, PNG
- For micro export orders, invoiceDateTime and invoiceNumber are required

### Error Situations
- If the shipment package belongs to another seller: "The shipment package does not belong to the specified seller. sellerId: X"
- When trying to upload to a package that already has an invoice: "The invoice for the package number {paketNO} has already been sent"
- If package not found: "The shipment package with the ID {paketNO} could not be found"
- Invalid file format: "File type (.txt) is not supported. Supported file types: application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png"
- If file not sent: "File not sent. Please select the invoice file and try again"
- If invoice number missing for Micro: "Invoice information is required for Micro export types"
- If date missing for Micro: "Invoice information is required for Micro export types"

### TR (Turkey) Orders
There is no JSON request body. You must send the following fields as form-data:
- shipmentPackageId: as form-data (Text)
- file: as form-data (File) - PDF, JPEG, or PNG

### Micro Export Orders
You must send the following fields as form-data:
- shipmentPackageId: as form-data (Text)
- invoiceDateTime: as form-data (Text) - Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds)
- invoiceNumber: as form-data (Text)
- file: as form-data (File) - PDF, JPEG, or PNG

invoiceDateTime.description:
Invoice date - Unix timestamp format, greater than 0, 10 digits (seconds) or 13 digits (milliseconds).
Required for micro export orders, optional for others.

invoiceNumber.description:
Invoice number - Required for micro export orders, optional for others.
Format rules: First 3 characters alphanumeric, last 13 characters numeric (total 16).

file.description: Invoice file (PDF, JPEG, or PNG format, maximum 10 MB)

400.description:
Bad Request - Invalid request parameters. Possible errors:
- File size exceeds 10 MB
- Future-dated invoice
- Invalid file format
- File not sent
- Missing information for micro order (invoiceDateTime or invoiceNumber)

403.description: Forbidden - Shipment package does not belong to specified seller

404.description: Not Found - Specified package ID not found

409.description: Conflict - Invoice already sent for this package

basicAuth.description: Seller API Key and API Secret with Basic Auth
